commands.name: protected-generator-verify
command: import hashlib,json,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; m=json.loads(Path("docs/engineering/c3-closure-evidence/package/c4-common40-baseline-manifest.json").read_text()); protected=[x for x in m["protected_files"] if hashlib.sha256(Path(x["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=x["sha256"]]; generated=[{"path":x["path"],"sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(x["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"unchanged":hashlib.sha256(Path(x["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x["sha256"]} for x in m["generators"]]; result={"baseline_commit":m["baseline_commit"],"protected_file_count":len(m["protected_files"]),"protected_touch_count":len(protected),"generators":generated,"changed_paths":subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only",m["baseline_commit"]],text=True).splitlines()}; Path("docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence/protection.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n"); print(json.dumps(result,indent=2)); assert not protected and all(x["unchanged"] for x in generated)

commands.name: fixture-baseline-check
command: import hashlib,json; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("tests/fixtures/ext01-material-v1.record"); r={"baseline_commit":"b740b374c934f3b4624a21247b9a5deeb2ca6bf4","fixture_path":str(p),"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"producer":"docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence/freeze-material-v1.cpp","producer_was_compiled_before_schema_edit":True,"baseline_binary_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path("build-ext01-core/freeze-material-v1").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}; assert r["sha256"]=="ae21094749106dfe32cdce3ce20e0a0a728c14de2894524c820f01cb341422ed"; Path("docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence/fixture-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+"\n"); print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))

commands.name: delivery-read-accounting
command: import json; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence"); print("files:"); print("\n".join(sorted(x.name for x in p.iterdir()))); print("context entries:"); print((p/"context.jsonl").read_text()); print("protection:"); print((p/"protection.json").read_text()); print("fixture provenance:"); print((p/"fixture-provenance.json").read_text())

commands.name: accounting-log-summary
command: import json;from pathlib import Path; entries=[json.loads(x) for x in Path("docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence/commands.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()];print(json.dumps({"entries":len(entries),"oversized_legacy":[{"name":e["name"],"bytes":e["disk_utf8_bytes"],"complete":e.get("delivered_complete_output"),"delivered":e.get("delivered_utf8_bytes")} for e in entries if e["disk_utf8_bytes"]>16000],"failures":[{"name":e["name"],"exit":e["exit_code"]} for e in entries if e["exit_code"]]},indent=2))

commands.name: accounting-log-summary-repair
command: import json;from pathlib import Path; entries=[json.loads(x) for x in Path("docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence/commands.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()];print(json.dumps({"entries":len(entries),"first":entries[:2],"oversized_legacy":[{"name":e.get("name"),"bytes":e.get("disk_utf8_bytes",e.get("utf8_bytes")),"complete":e.get("delivered_complete_output"),"delivered":e.get("delivered_utf8_bytes")} for e in entries if e.get("disk_utf8_bytes",e.get("utf8_bytes",0))>16000],"failures":[{"name":e.get("name"),"exit":e.get("exit_code")} for e in entries if e.get("exit_code")]},indent=2))

commands.name: compact-legacy-accounting
command: import json;from pathlib import Path; e=[json.loads(x) for x in Path("docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence/commands.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()];print(json.dumps([{k:r.get(k) for k in ["name","kind","disk_utf8_bytes","delivered_utf8_bytes","delivered_complete_output","exit_code"]} for r in e if r.get("disk_utf8_bytes",r.get("delivered_utf8_bytes",0))>15000],indent=2))

commands.name: accounting-runner-version-boundary
command: import json;from pathlib import Path;e=[json.loads(x) for x in Path("docs/engineering/c4-ext01-evidence/commands.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()];print(json.dumps({"first_disk_byte_entries":[{k:x.get(k) for k in ["name","disk_utf8_bytes","delivered_utf8_bytes","delivery_range"]} for x in e if "disk_utf8_bytes" in x][:6],"legacy_count":sum("disk_utf8_bytes" not in x for x in e)},indent=2))
